input.title: Men's Sailing – I'm Not Lost. I'm Tacking. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

I'M NOT LOST. I'M TACKING. is the sailing hoodie for the sailor who zigzags toward the harbor and calls it a plan, worn on the dock, on cold watches and as a gift from a crew that has seen the heading.

I'M NOT LOST. runs across the top in tall condensed capitals and I'M TACKING. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a small sailboat heels over in choppy water while a sailor in a cable-knit sweater and captain's cap leans out to balance, a seagull flies the other way and a striped lighthouse stands far behind.

Navy carries cream and faded red lettering with a cream edge around the boat; Sand gets navy and faded red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this sailing hoodie warm enough for cold docks and windy evenings?
Yes. The I'm Not Lost. I'm Tacking. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cold watches, windy docks and evenings on the water.

How does the I'm Not Lost. I'm Tacking. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a sailor?
It is a natural one. Every sailor has zigzagged upwind and called it a plan, so it lands with crew mates, dock neighbors and the family that waits ashore. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the boat scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the I'm Not Lost. I'm Tacking. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
